title: The Fruit of the Spirit
reflectionQuestion: God loves to grow good things in your heart, like kindness, joy, and peace. Which one would you most like to share with someone?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Comfort & Bedtime, comfort-ritual short-only) -- the disciplined FINAL add, completing the comfort-ritual quartet (Psalm 23 / Lord's Prayer / Beatitudes / Fruit of the Spirit). Emotional room = 'the good things God GROWS in your heart' (becoming kind/gentle) -- the one room nothing else squarely covered. Gentle apple-tree frame makes the abstract concrete; the nine fruits rendered warmly + kid-simply (patience='wait without fussing', self-control='stop and choose what is right'), NOT a dry list. Crucial framing per god-with-not-cause + no-self-improvement-pressure: 'you do not have to grow these by yourself or all at once... they grow as you stay close to God' -- it's God's gift, not a to-do list for the child. Soft bedtime close. WEB-faithful but child-rendered (like the Beatitudes). 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_PRISCILLA_TEACHER (clear, gentle-instructive; varies from Arabella's three comfort-rituals). scriptureKeyVerse.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
